item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
After the follow-up, the final result is square 1:1 (the user changed the shape from any shape); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it square and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, photorealistic high-end fragrance advertising. A single elegant smoked amber glass candle jar with creamy ivory wax and a small lit flame, thick glass base, restrained matte ivory label with crisp minimal black typography reading 'EMBER' and smaller 'Scented Candle'. Brushed brass lid resting beside the jar. Sculptural warm beige travertine pedestal, seamless warm taupe studio background, subtle hint of sandalwood and one dried botanical placed sparingly near the base. Beautiful controlled side lighting, soft golden glow, rich natural shadows, delicate glass reflections, tactile materials, sophisticated warm neutral palette, meticulous composition with generous negative space. Hero product in sharp focus, shallow depth of field, luxury editorial still life, no people, no clutter, no extra products, no watermark.
